publication.title: New sauropod dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous of Morella (Spain) provides new insights on the evolutionary history of Iberian somphospondylan titanosauriforms
publication.journal: Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society
authors: J. M. Gasulla, A. Galobart, B. Poza, A. Santos-Cubedo, J. L. Sanz, F. Ortega

locality.name: PBDB collection 45153: located on W pericline of río Bergantes anticline, oriented N60°E. 4 km SW of Morella.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 45153 to Late Barremian with numeric bounds 125.77–121.4 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 85869; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 458327 records Somphospondyli in collection 45153, linked by PBDB to reference 85869.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Somphospondyli indet. and the accepted name as Somphospondyli.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 168887 to Late Barremian with numeric bounds 125.77–121.4 Ma.
